detail.longDescription: Agent memory poisoning needs no injection. A new paper poisoned 1.2% of a LongMemEval corpus with plainly worded false statements, no instructions or triggers, and accuracy fell from 0.850 to 0.300. A write-time screening pipeline with 0.832 recall on indirect prompt injection rejected 0 of 360 poisoned memories. Filters catch text that gives orders. A false claim reads just like a true one. https:// arxiv.org/abs/2608.21230 # AIAgents # LLMSecurity # PromptInjection # AgentMemory
